requirements.text: Use Jamaican roots dub and exclude dubstep and EDM drops.
Feature saxophone answers and a saxophone solo.
Use natural restrained singing with few vocal runs. This is not an instrumental.
The source rehearsal recording must actually be attached before submitting.

proposal.styles: Jamaican roots dub, bass-led live band, saxophone replies and saxophone solo, natural restrained vocals with minimal ornamentation.
proposal.excluded_styles: dubstep, EDM drops, elaborate vocal runs
